summary: Iteration 20: Testing 6 new features for IronVision AI. Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI tests passed. Features verified: (1) Auto-Remediation Code Generation - generates Terraform/CloudFormation/Kubernetes code for findings, (2) Expanded RBAC with 5 roles (admin/auditor/system_owner/remediation_engineer/viewer), (3) OSCAL SSP Export with full system-security-plan structure, (4) Natural Language Compliance Interrogation using GPT-5.2, (5) Predictive Risk Forecasting with warnings and predictions, (6) Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) with vendor intake form and 15-question risk questionnaire.
seed_data_creation: 4 vendors pre-seeded (CloudSyncInc, DataVault Pro, SecureAuth Solutions, PayStream Global). 3 users in RBAC (Demo Admin, Demo Viewer, Kevin Hill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 tested 6 NEW features. Key endpoints: (1) POST /api/remediation/generate - generates IaC code (terraform/cloudformation/kubernetes) for findings. Uses template matching for encryption, MFA, TLS, firewall, logging, patch, session, backup. Returns remediation object with template_code and ai_code. (2) GET /api/remediation/templates - lists 8 templates. (3) GET /api/remediation/history - lists generated remediations. (4) GET /api/rbac/roles - returns 5 roles with permissions (admin=43, auditor=14, system_owner=30, remediation_engineer=16, viewer=12). (5) GET /api/rbac/users - lists users with roles. (6) GET /api/rbac/my-permissions - returns current user role and permissions. (7) PUT /api/rbac/assign - admin-only role assignment. (8) GET /api/oscal/export/ssp - exports full OSCAL SSP with metadata, system-characteristics, control-implementation, back-matter, and optional plan-of-action-and-milestones. (9) POST /api/interrogate/ask - natural language compliance questions using GPT-5.2 (10-30s response time). (10) GET /api/forecasting/predict - returns predictions, warnings, and data_points. (11) POST /api/tprm/vendors - create vendor. (12) GET /api/tprm/vendors - list vendors. (13) GET /api/tprm/vendors/{id} - vendor detail with assessments. (14) DELETE /api/tprm/vendors/{id} - delete vendor. (15) PUT /api/tprm/vendors/{id}/status - update status (pending/approved/conditional/rejected/review_needed). (16) GET /api/tprm/questionnaire - 15 questions with categories and control_ids. (17) POST /api/tprm/assess - submit assessment with responses, calculates risk_score with data_access_level multiplier. (18) GET /api/tprm/dashboard - TPRM stats. Frontend: TPRM page at /vendors with data-testid='tprm-page', 'add-vendor-btn', 'vendors-list', 'vendor-{id}', 'assess-{id}'. Add vendor form with 'vendor-name', 'vendor-email', 'vendor-category', 'vendor-access', 'save-vendor-btn'. Assessment page with 'tprm-assess', 'q-Q{n}', 'ans-Q{n}-{yes|partial|no|n/a}', 'submit-assessment-btn'. Settings RBAC tab with 'rbac-tab', 'rbac-manager', 'role-cards', 'role-card-{role}', 'users-list', 'user-row-{id}', 'role-select-{id}'.
